comparison.objective: Scoop exactly one meatball onto a plate without utensil cross-contamination.
comparison.physical_skill: Utensil-supported acquisition, transport, release, and contamination-aware contact management versus aperture-mediated filtering.
comparison.success_condition: Exactly one actual scoop-and-delivery; full credit requires clean utensil and no contamination, with released stable placement.
comparison.reason: Both involve selecting from multiple bodies, but this tests single-item serving and hygiene, not bulk size separation.
